SUEQ.description: Seismic Load Scale Factors for Design (SUEQ). Scale factors applied to earthquake load-case and load-combination results (axial, moment, shear) used in the design calculation.

LC_AXIAL.description: Load case axial force scale factor for earthquake results (maps to dEqLcaseN).

LC_MOMENT.description: Load case moment scale factor for earthquake results (maps to dEqLcaseM).

LC_SHEAR.description: Load case shear force scale factor for earthquake results (maps to dEqLcaseV).

LCOM_AXIAL.description: Load combination axial force scale factor for earthquake results (maps to dEqLcomN).

LCOM_MOMENT.description: Load combination moment scale factor for earthquake results (maps to dEqLcomM).

LCOM_SHEAR.description: Load combination shear force scale factor for earthquake results (maps to dEqLcomV).
